origin: External expert review of plan V2.0 recommended a TRAIN-only out-of-fold variance re-estimation as the one legitimate way to test the power floor without waiting for new data
purpose: Re-estimate the nuisance variance of the per-fixture paired five-state NLL difference using out-of-fold predictions only, and re-derive the validation-N detectable effect under a cluster contract that is actually implemented as written.
explicitly_not_a_model_experiment: This produces no model comparison conclusion. It does not rank comparator against challenger, does not authorise promotion, and does not modify or reopen U2.

relationship_to_u2.u2_status: CLOSED at INSUFFICIENT_POWER_DO_NOT_SCORE; not reopened, not amended

data_boundary.validation: SEALED. No validation fixture is loaded, scored, or inspected.

primary_score_identity.note: frozen here because U2 omitted it
primary_score_identity.market_weights: OU and AH enter with equal total weight per market
primary_score_identity.within_fixture_aggregation: d_i = mean over markets of (mean over that market's lines of (NLL_comparator - NLL_challenger))
primary_score_identity.note_on_change_from_u2: U2 used a flat mean over all 16 lines, which weights AH 11/16 and OU 5/16. This preregistration switches to equal weight per market and reports both, so the scale difference is measurable rather than hidden.

fold_design.blocks: TRAIN fixtures sorted by kickoff_at then fixture_id, cut into 6 contiguous blocks of equal fixture count
fold_design.folds: for k in 1..5: fit challenger on blocks 1..k, produce OOF predictions for block k+1
fold_design.challenger_fit: identical algorithm to U2: L2 Poisson IRLS, features [intercept, home_field, attack_xg_for, opponent_xg_against, elo_gap], lambda_l2=1.0, max_iter=100, tol=1e-10, deterministic
fold_design.temperature: NOT refitted; temperature is a 1X2-scope object and does not enter the five-state primary

cluster_contract.estimator: block bootstrap over (league x calendar-month) cells, resampling cells with replacement
cluster_contract.rationale: the reviewer noted 13 leagues is too few for standard cluster-robust asymptotics; a cell bootstrap over league-month avoids relying on small-G asymptotics while still respecting both league and time structure
also_reported: one-way kickoff-date clustered SE (for comparability with the U2 figure)
cluster_contract.implementation_must_match_contract: if the implemented estimator differs from this text in any respect, the run fails closed and the deviation is disclosed rather than silently accepted

required: mean and SD of OOF d_i (mean reported as nuisance context only, NOT as an effect estimate)
implied detectable effect at validation N = 2790 for a one-sided 5% test at 80% power against H0: delta <= 0
forbidden: any statement that one model is better
any use of the OOF mean as evidence of effect
any adjustment to MME, split, min_history, line grid, or cohort based on these numbers

interpretation_rule.if_se_similar: the U2 power floor is corroborated; the waiting-time estimate stands
interpretation_rule.if_se_materially_smaller: the U2 floor was pessimistic; a new power design may be worth preregistering, but no existing conclusion changes
interpretation_rule.if_se_materially_larger: the U2 floor was optimistic and the required N is larger than 5,859
interpretation_rule.in_all_cases: this does not by itself authorise executing any scoring experiment; MME role and decision utility remain open questions for external argument
